ety.text: Learned borrowing from Biblical Hebrew ישוע (yēšū́aʿ). Hindi translations of the Bible make a distinction between Jesus and Joshua, referring to Jesus as यीशु (yīśu) and Joshua as यहोशू (yahośū).
